title: Seminar in World Histories of Art
description: An exploration of different cultural perspectives for conceptualizing artistic works and practices. Topics may include comparisons as well as examinations of specific intercultural and cross-cultural contacts.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of AHVS 411, AHVS 511, HA 411 (if taken in the same topic).
A combined undergraduate and graduate course.

items.text: Minimum 3 units of 300-level AHVS or HA courses
